rs.innovation_approach: 把轮级与token级策略梯度写为同一token logprob结构，混合两种GAE；用含轮内折扣奖励的混合return训练同一个critic，避免两个价值模型。
rs.key_step: A_hyb=α A_turn+(1−α)A_token；actor所有生成token用混合优势。critic目标用α G_turn,broadcast+(1−α)G_token，其中轮级return回播需加该位置到轮尾的折扣微奖励，默认α=.5。
rs.why_non_obvious: 轮级信号避免跨大量推理token衰减但失去轮内差别，token信号有细粒度差别却受序列长度影响；共享critic不能只把同一轮return平铺。作者用折扣对齐和价值等价作理论依据，但原文条件历史/索引存在待核问题，实验有效性不能代替证明。
rs.trigger_condition: When one interaction turn contains many generated tokens and feedback arrives at turn boundaries, combine turn- and token-scale advantages and fit a shared critic with position-aware mixed return targets, after checking reward, discount and history alignment.

rs.abstract_strategy: Express two temporal resolutions in a common update form, mix their estimates, and share the predictor using aligned targets.
rs.abstract_key_step: Broadcast the coarse estimate to fine positions, preserve fine-position variation through a convex mixture, and reconstruct each training target with the intervening discounted signals.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: A common predictor can reduce duplication only when its conditioning state and return target agree across resolutions; a superficial broadcast can train incompatible values.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When one coarse action consists of many fine decisions with delayed feedback, align histories and rewards before mixing estimates and sharing their predictor.

signatures.object: Actor advantage tensor over reasoning and executable-action tokens across turns
signatures.information: Completed on-policy trajectories contain observation/action/reward history, generated token indices and turn boundaries, plus jointly learned critic estimates. GAE training targets use later realized rewards/values; policy and critic conditionals are written on prefixes, not a GT future trajectory prompt. Environment-specific privileges are material: VIRL executor has GT route and only executes aligned actions; Primitive Skill observations include object coordinates.
signatures.operation: Compute turn-wise and token-wise TD/GAE estimates from the same rollout, broadcast the turn advantage across its generated tokens, mix with token advantage at α=.5, and optimize token likelihood ratios with PPO clipping.
signatures.output: Every generated token receives A_hyb; no explicit crop-only sign table, answer-now fork, independent semantic judge or process-reward model.

Rich simulator feedback and action formats used in evaluation

evidence.quote:
We ablate the mixing coefficient α used in both the hybrid advantage in Eq. (13) and the hybrid
return in Eq. (17), where α controls the balance between turn-level and token-level signals. In this
setting, α = 0 corresponds to Token PPO, α = 1 reduces to Turn PPO with broadcasted values,
and α = 0.5 is our default configuration. As shown in Table 2, the default choice α = 0.5 achieves
the best performance on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and Primitive Skill. The intermediate mixtures also
generally outperform the pure turn-wise setting, suggesting that combining token-level and turn-level
credit assignment provides a more reliable training signal.

signatures.failure_boundary: No direct/crop efficiency or zero-support recovery test. Same α changes both actor and critic targets, so this ablation does not isolate actor mixing. Primitive Skill α.25/.75=.73 is worse than pure token.98. Clipping, approximate critic and nonaggregated KL break any simple exact-gradient assertion.

signatures.object: Unified critic training targets at turn boundaries and intermediate token positions
signatures.information: One learned Vψ is used for token estimates and at turn-ending locations for turn estimates. Critic training target combines sampled future rewards with bootstrap values; it is trained with actor rather than a frozen external reader. The formal τ_turn excludes current action while τ_token_end includes generated tokens, so information equivalence is not established by matching γ alone.
signatures.operation: Construct G_token=A_token+V(prefix); construct G_turn,broadcast=A_turn+sum of discounted within-turn rewards+V(turn); mix returns using the same α and regress shared critic to that target; use constant turn value for the turn-advantage baseline.
signatures.output: One critic supporting two GAE granularities, with corrected target variation across a turn.
signatures.claimed_effect: Figure4 Sokoban validation: full.83, Token-PPO.59, uniform-value target.42, no-critic REINFORCE.00; choice of turn baseline.83 vs broadcasted turn-value baseline.68. This supports tested implementation choices, not the exact value identity proof.
conditions: Position of endpoint value and reward accumulation are defined consistently
No reward double counting between boundary reward and broadcast micro-rewards
Critic target is treated as a target during regression; actual detach/mask code not inspected

evidence.quote:
The return must be precise. The formulation of the mixed return in Eq. (17) is critical. We observe
that alternative choices, such as broadcasting the turn-level return uniformly across all tokens within
a turn or omitting the value model entirely (i.e., using REINFORCE), lead to training collapse, as
shown in Fig. 4. This observation aligns with known challenges in PPO for language models, where
training the value model is difficult Shen et al. (2024); Sheng et al. (2024). The formulation of the
hybrid return in Eq. (17) provides the precise target and necessary variance reduction to stabilize the
value function Vψ throughout training.

signatures.failure_boundary: Theorem2 claims start-history/end-token value equality without resolving changed conditioning; App.A Eq27 and reward indexing need independent mathematical audit. Critic architecture/init, λ and separate discount settings are incompletely reported. Shared critic saves a second critic conceptually, without measured GPU-hour/memory advantage.

moves.quote:
This generation–interaction loop can be viewed at either the turn or token scale, leading to distinct POMDP formulations and corresponding RL training strategies. Below, we detail these two
perspectives.
moves.note: 实际分别定义token行动与整轮宏动作，Eq7分解logprob；实验还允许每轮多动作，turn不能当作一次环境action。

moves.quote:
Aggregation of small token-wise rewards is optional. As discussed in Section 4.3, strictly
speaking, additional token-level rewards, e.g., KL-divergence penalties, should be aggregated into
the turn reward when computing the turn-level advantages. This ensures that the system provides
exactly the same reward from the token-wise and turn-wise RL perspectives. However, since these
rewards are typically small, we show in Fig. 4 that aggregating them at the turn level or not leads to
similar results.
moves.note: 实际对照是否把微小KL奖励聚合到turn reward：.80 vs .83；只针对该开关，不将α同时改变actor和critic叫作独立actor机制证明。

moves.quote:
We compare the finetuning performance of the
Qwen2.5-VL-3B backbone using standard reinforcement learning methods, including TokenPPO Schulman et al. (2017); Ouyang et al. (2022), Turn-PPO Schulman et al. (2017); Chen
et al. (2025), GRPO Guo et al. (2025), RL4VLM Zhai et al. (2024), and VAGEN-Base Wang
et al. (2025a).
moves.note: 实际用Token/Turn-PPO、GRPO、RL4VLM、VAGEN命名对照；不是泛泛声称用标准RL。

moves.quote:
The two estimators focus on different properties during training. As shown in Fig. 2, the turn-wise
advantage estimation remains constant across the turn. This preserves the turn-level reward signal
and avoids excessive discounting through intermediate reasoning tokens. Conversely, the token-wise
advantage estimation provides fine-grained advantage values for each individual token, preserving
within-turn differentiation.
Existing methods typically employ either estimator independently or use one signal to guide the
other when both advantages are considered. The equivalence above provides a theoretical basis for
optimizing with both advantage signals without introducing hierarchical modeling; instead, the two
signals can be directly hybridized.
moves.note: 作者实际展开共同surrogate并给Theorems1–2/App.A证明，进而统一混合和critic；标记执行该研究动作不表示本读者确认其定理正确。

moves.quote:
This equivalence implies that we can use
exactly one shared value model, Vψ , which provides turn-wise values at the end of the turn and
token-wise values at intermediate token positions.
moves.note: 共享同一价值预测器与混合return目标；不是仅关键词共享模型。
